comments.author: bakabaka
comments.body:
Yo, if you're doing the Ephesus Legacy to obtain the chair pursuit, seems this is the core quest.

You must obtain the discover, not only the map like the Alexandria's one.

Consider bringing more than 1 of this map from calicut since maybe you wont get the chair prophecy at first try. This way you can stick to Europe collecting the other clues.
